summary: Tenofovir Alafenamide carries an official boxed warning in the United States for liver harm, and the drug label warns that stopping it may cause severe flare-ups of hepatitis B, an infection of the liver [3][6]. The drug label also includes warnings about new or worsening kidney problems and immune system flare-ups [6]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a high risk score for liver issues and a low risk score for heart issues [M]. Similar drugs also carry boxed warnings for liver harm, immune system issues, body chemical balance problems, and kidney damage [4][5].
